spellbook.finance/limitations: The link works for 30 minutes and for this one copy only. expiresAt says when. Fetch a fresh link if the seller comes back later.

Only the seller opens the link. The page takes one front photo and one back photo, converts each to JPEG and removes location and camera data before it is stored. Either side may be skipped. A new upload replaces the earlier photo of the same side.

The photos are public once stored, because eBay loads listing pictures from a public address. currentPhotoUrl shows the front photo already on the copy and currentBackPhotoUrl shows the back photo, each null when there is none.

Only the next spellbook_ebay_publish of this copy uses the photo. A listing that is already live on eBay keeps its pictures. To change a live listing, call spellbook_ebay_unpublish for it, then spellbook_ebay_publish again.

The listing shows the front photo, then the back photo, then catalog art. For any finish other than non-foil, such as foil, holo, reverse holo or etched, the listing keeps catalog art first and shows the front and back photos after it, so buyers still see the printing's foil art.
Getting the link changes nothing. The seller's upload is the write, and it lists nothing on any marketplace.
Only a workspace owner or admin gets a link, because the upload replaces a public listing picture. A member gets 403 forbidden.

annotations.title: Get a photo upload link for one card

description: Get a link where the seller uploads their own phone photos of the front and the back of one inventory copy, so the next eBay listing shows that exact card beside catalog art. Use it when the seller wants buyers to see the real card, when a buyer asks to see the back, or when catalog art is wrong or missing. Take itemId from spellbook_inventory_items_query or spellbook_inventory_holdings. Give the seller the returned url and tell them to open it on their phone, then take or pick a photo of the card front and a photo of the card back. No photo passes through you. After they say the photos are saved, call spellbook_ebay_publish for that copy.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

itemId.description: One inventory copy's itemId, from spellbook_inventory_items_query or spellbook_inventory_holdings. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that holds the copy. The caller must own it. Required.
